Why Python's requests Library Is So Popular

The requests library is widely used because it makes HTTP calls simple.1

Key Reasons for Its Popularity

1. Remarkably Simple API

Fetching a web resource requires nothing more than requests.get(url).

2. Battle-Tested Maturity

It handles redirects, decoding, SSL verification, and timeouts.2
